about: What a shared link may be, read by the bridge (bridge/publish/share.mjs) and repeated by the plugin (src/services/share-link.ts). Both suites check their constants against this file, so a limit changed on one side fails a test on both.
codeWords: three to eight letters a to z, two of them joined by a hyphen, a number from 10 to 99 after a third hyphen for a link without a password
